column3:
2.4 trillion parameters is the headline.

95 billion active parameters is the operational story.

Alibaba's newly announced Qwen3.8-Max uses a mixture-of-experts design that activates only a fraction of the model for each request.

For platform teams, that distinction matters more than leaderboard screenshots.

Before introducing any large model into production, check four things:

- Active compute per request - not just total model size
- Latency and throughput at your real concurrency
- Cost per completed workflow - not cost per token alone
- A safe routing and rollback path when quality drifts

The teams that get value from AI will not be the ones chasing the biggest model.

They will be the ones building the platform discipline to use the right model, safely and predictably.

What metric decides whether a new model earns a place in your stack?
